questiondescription.text:
Navigation: differences in latitude and longitude

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.7 (a, b) / Essential 2.3 (a, b): Find the difference in latitude and the difference in longitude of two places, in degrees and minutes.

Core and Essential

This question is adapted from Chapter 3 (The sphere), Exercise C, question 8 and Exercise D, question 4 of School Mathematics Project, SMP Book 5 (Metric), ed. P. G. Bowie, Cambridge University Press, 1969: differences of latitude and longitude; Kenyan and world places, new positions.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
